design_A_hanabi:
Image 1 is the ART STYLE reference ONLY — do NOT draw that young man; draw the new woman described below. Art style EXACTLY like image 1: soft modern cel animation with a light, airy palette — thin coloured lineart (dark lavender instead of black), flat pastel colours with one soft-edged but still flat shadow tone, simple clean backgrounds with a few round lights, gentle and romantic like an anime film. Hand-drawn feel, NOT glossy: no airbrush gradients, no bloom, no heavy glow, no over-detailed strands. Realistic adult proportions (about 7 heads tall, not chibi), a beautiful adult face. Original character, not a real person.

Hayase Nagisa, 20, the viewer's tomboyish childhood friend, home for the summer break. Usually in T-shirts and sneakers, sporty and blunt, but tonight she is, for once, wearing a yukata — and is embarrassed about it. Slightly sun-tanned skin, a sporty slim build. Colour theme: soda blue and sparkler orange. Chestnut-brown hair in a high ponytail tied with a plain orange hair tie, short side-swept bangs, a few loose strands, bright amber eyes; a navy-blue yukata with small white-and-orange firework patterns, a simple orange half-width obi. Expression: looking away to the side with a grumpy blush, one hand rubbing the back of her neck.

Upper-body portrait from the waist up on the flat rooftop of an old apartment building on a summer night (a low railing, a water tank, the lights of a small town below, a deep blue night sky with a few stars), she looks at the viewer with the expression described. No text, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no frame.

Avoid: chibi, super-deformed, childish face, realistic photo, 3D render, glossy, airbrushed, bloom, extra fingers, deformed hands, text, letters, the man from image 1, heavy makeup, princess look.
